en.headline: Visitor facilitation schemes expanded to social welfare and Central Asia
en.dek: From 1 October the short-term activities scheme will cover social welfare, while the invited persons scheme will extend beyond ASEAN to Central Asia and the Middle East.
body: The government announced on Thursday that two immigration facilitation schemes will be expanded from 1 October to attract more non-local talent and invited visitors.

The scheme for visitors participating in short-term activities in designated sectors will add social welfare as an 18th sector. More authorised organisations and activities will also be included in international and mega events, higher education and finance. Participants may stay up to 14 consecutive days and receive remuneration for the specified activities without applying for employment visas.

Separately, the Immigration Facilitation Scheme for Invited Persons will expand from ASEAN member states to countries and regions in Central Asia and the Middle East, including Kazakhstan, Uzbekistan, Saudi Arabia and the United Arab Emirates. All government bureaux and departments will be able to issue invitations, with one-stop electronic processing and relaxed self-service clearance eligibility.

zh.headline: 短期訪客計劃增社福界 特邀人士計劃擴至中亞中東
zh.dek: 政府公布10月1日起擴展兩項入境便利計劃，短期訪客計劃新增社會福利界別，特邀人士計劃則由東盟延伸至中亞及中東國家。
body: 政府今日宣布，將於10月1日起擴展兩項入境便利計劃，便利更多非本地人才及特邀人士來港。
「為來港參與指定界別短期活動的訪客提供入境便利計劃」將新增「社會福利」界別，使指定界別增至18個，並在國際／大型活動、高等教育及金融三個原有界別增加認可機構及指定短期活動。獲邀人士可以訪客身分來港參與指定活動，每次不超過連續14個曆日，並可收取報酬，無須申請工作簽證。
「特邀人士入境便利計劃」則由現時的東盟成員國擴展至中亞及中東國家及地區，包括哈薩克、烏茲別克、沙特阿拉伯及阿聯酋等，並容許所有政策局或部門發出邀請。入境處將透過電子平台一站式處理申請，並放寬自助通關資格。
